name: Microsoft Azure Linux Virtual Machines Pricing
notes: Rendered pricing page, defaults to a monthly display and a region selector; the ND-series table rows it does render are month-based pay-as-you-go: ND96isr H100 v5 $71,773.60/month with ~81% 'Spot' (the table's last column, mislabelled - it is the spot/discount column) at $13,263.7613/month; ND96asr A100 v4 $19,853.81/month; NC40ads H100 v5 $5,095.40/month. Crucially the page states 'Pricing is not available in the selected region' for the ND H200 v5 series - which is why the H200 figure here comes from the Retail Prices API instead. Also: the page shows 'Reserved instances' and 'Savings plan' columns as '-' for ND96isr H100 v5, i.e. no reservation product published on this page for that SKU.
